sources.panel_size: TRAKTOR KONTROL S4 MK3 Manual English (3.0 edition), section 11 Specification: Width 542 mm, Height 65 mm, Depth 339 mm
sources.wire: none published: the unit drives Traktor over HID and has no MIDI message list; every control's midi is null (wire unavailable), nothing is invented
sources.positions: measured trace of the official overview rendering, normalised for the renderer; reference: devices/traktor-s4-mk3/panel.reference.json (ADR-0137)

out_of_scope: every control is unwired (midi null) and inert: no MIDI list exists, so nothing is bound and nothing lights
shift_midi: the manual documents SHIFT functions but no wires, so every shifted row is null
the deck display (section 5.1 callout 15), level meters and input LEDs are not controls
the jog rim and plate are one control: the renderer has no ring type yet
TEMPO is a vertical fader drawn from its rectangle; the renderer has no orientation hint
front panel (crossfader curve and assign switches, sockets) and rear panel
